lesson-intro.text: A satellite is a can with two wings of solar panels and a dish that listens. Build it from the body out, then send one up.

body.text: The body is a can standing on its end, leaning to the left. Draw its right side.

body-2.text: Come back to the top and take the left side down to meet it.

caps.text: A dome caps each end. Draw the line across the top, then the curve around the bottom.

port.text: One round port sits on the front of the can.

panel-left.text: Now the left wing. A short arm holds a long panel, split into six panes.

panel-right.text: The right wing matches it: arm, panel, then the lines that make six panes.

dish.text: A short arm lifts the dish above the body. The dish is a shallow bowl, tipped up to the right.

feed.text: A thin arm reaches out of the dish to a little ball.

body-color.text: Color the body and the little ball yellow.

panels.text: Color both panels blue, and the round port too.

gray-parts.text: The domes and the dish are gray. The arms are a darker gray.

lesson-outro.text: Your satellite is out there listening. Which way is its dish pointing?
